name: raanankacak
_overrides: Both entries pin a transitive dependency of `next` past a published advisory. npm's own suggested fix is `npm audit fix --force`, which installs next@9.3.3 — a six-year downgrade across seven major versions, and not a fix. The advisory range for next itself covers every released 16.x, so there is no version to upgrade to; the vulnerable packages are the ones to move. Remove an entry once next ships a release that already depends on a patched version, and let lib/dependencies.test.ts fail if that regresses.
